title: Version history
description: Project checkpoints. Restoring overwrites the current state on disk.

saveDialog.title: Save version
saveDialog.description: Give this checkpoint a name so you can find it later.

history.emptyWithAutos: No manual versions. Turn on “Show automatic backups” to see internal history.
history.compareNeedsFile: Open a file to compare it with a version.

restoreDialog.title: Restore this version?
restoreDialog.description: The entire project will be replaced with the contents of “{{name}}”. Unsaved changes in open tabs will be lost.

diff.title: Compare with current file
diff.description: Version “{{name}}” vs current contents of {{path}}. Green = added; red strikethrough = removed in the older version.
diff.legend: Select strikethrough text and use “Copy removed text” to rescue a fragment without restoring the whole project.
diff.empty: No differences between that version and the current file.
diff.removed: Text removed in the older version

errors.error.snapshot.name_required: Enter a name for the version.
errors.error.snapshot.nothing_to_commit: There are no new changes since the last version.
errors.error.snapshot.stage_failed: Could not prepare the version save.
errors.error.snapshot.prune_failed: Could not apply automatic backup retention.
errors.error.snapshot.diff_too_large: The file exceeds the comparison limit (10,000 words).
errors.error.snapshot.diff_invalid: The content is not valid text.
errors.error.snapshot.file_not_in_version: That file did not exist in the selected version.
errors.error.git.init_failed: Could not set up project version history.
